_about: Filling the stadium: what scripts/scene/qa.py checks on every still and clip before Jack sees it. Each item comes from a note Jack or Matt gave (2026-11-24/25). Add to it whenever a new note names a fault.

still.fail_if: any footballer looks like a man
still.fix: name every player as a woman; re-roll

still.q: Does any person have extra or missing limbs, an extra arm or hand, fused or duplicated bodies, a melted face, or warped hands?
still.fix: re-roll; if one small figure, crop or blur it

still.q: Look at every person whose feet are off the ground. Is the height plausible for a real jump (feet no higher than about knee height), are the legs bent for take-off or landing, and is there a shadow on the grass directly below them? Also: is every standing or running person's foot touching the ground with a contact shadow?
still.fail_if: anyone floats: feet too high for a jump, straight legs in the air, or no shadow under them
still.fix: describe feet planted, the take-off or landing, the shadow under them; re-roll from words

still.q: Is there any readable text, letters, numbers, logo, crest, badge or brand mark anywhere: shirts (front and back), boards, screens, flags, scarves, the ball, staff bibs, signs?
still.fail_if: any mark that reads as text, a number or a logo
still.fix: describe the surface as plain and smooth; blur small marks in the edit; re-roll if large

still.q: Does anyone look cut out and pasted in: wrong scale for where they stand, wrong lighting, no shadow, edges that do not sit in the scene?
still.fix: regenerate the whole frame from words with the people part of the scene (no edit that adds people)

still.q: Looking at the faces you can make out (crowd, teams, families), is there a real mix of ethnicities, not all or nearly all white?
still.fail_if: everyone, or nearly everyone, visible is white
still.fix: describe the nearest faces one by one with heritage; give the crowd a stated mix; regenerate from words

still.q: Is any flag bigger than about one person?
still.fail_if: a flag bigger than a person (except the planned giant curtain flag in the walk-out shot)
still.fix: scarves held up and three or four tea-towel-sized flags on short sticks

still.q: Is a MATCH in play (players in match positions, the stand full, the goal, kick-off)? If so, are both teams there in full (roughly eleven red and eleven blue, plus a referee)? Before kick-off (warm-up, empty or filling stands, families arriving) a partly empty pitch is correct.
still.fail_if: a match is in play and a team is clearly short or missing
still.fix: attach a scripts/scene/formation.py layout and write the formation line by line

still.q: If the stadium is visible, does it match the REFERENCE: a red two-tier bowl, a red band with glass boxes between the tiers, one grey steel roof round a large open oval, a ring of floodlights?
still.fail_if: a clearly different roof, stand shape or seat colour
still.fix: attach the stadium still and describe it; re-roll

still.q: Does anything look like a real club or real stadium: a known kit pattern (for example red-and-white vertical stripes, red with white sleeves), a known crest, a famous stadium shape?
still.fail_if: a recognisable real club or ground
still.fix: plain solid red or blue kit and scarves; re-roll

still.q: Is any visible food clearly not vegetarian or not healthy (meat burgers, hot dogs, chips)?
still.fix: falafel, salads, grain bowls, veggie wraps; re-roll

still.q: Is anything else physically wrong: impossible geometry, duplicated people side by side, objects melting or merging, a ball or object hanging in the air with no reason?
still.fix: re-roll with the fault described away positively

clip.q: Does any person, face, limb or object morph, melt, split, merge or change identity during the clip?
clip.fix: fewer movers; keep the crowd still; re-roll

clip.q: Does anything jump position between frames, appear from nowhere or vanish (balls, people, food, flags)?
clip.fix: keep objects still or out of frame; cut on a reaction

clip.q: Do people's feet stay on the ground when they walk or run (no gliding, sliding or floating)?
Does readable text, a number or a logo appear at any point?
clip.fix: blur in the edit or re-roll

clip.fail_if: any looks like a man at any point

clip.q: Do flags or scarves behave like cloth, without morphing into other shapes or swallowing people?
clip.fix: fewer, smaller flags; scarves held still

clip.q: Is the camera motion smooth and believable, without warping the stadium or the people?
clip.fail_if: the set warps or the camera jerks
clip.fix: lock the camera and add the move in Premiere

clip.q: Is anything else physically wrong (fireworks or smoke that behave unnaturally, a ball with no physics, liquids)?
clip.fix: keep it out of frame or still; re-roll
